title: revision-request/v1
description: nodes/<id>/revisions/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml (D-8; F08-R6): a contributor's claim that a statement is defective — never a request to weaken it, which is a variant (D-30). Names the defect class from D-16's taxonomy and carries evidence: free text, capped and served as untrusted data (D-28), and optionally a Lean exhibit the gate elaborates in the sandbox (C9). A curator acts on it by versioning the node (D-8); the record itself changes nothing.

exhibit.description: a Lean file; it must elaborate in the append gate or the pull request fails (F08-R6)

defect_class.description: D-16's taxonomy: the six canary classes (D-11), strength-drift (D-9), and other-with-exhibit
